name: genome/train/resume
description: Resume a crashed or failed training job from its latest checkpoint. Looks up the TrainingJobEntity, verifies checkpoint exists on disk, and restarts genome/train with resumeFromCheckpoint pointing to the latest checkpoint directory.

params.name: jobId
params.description: TrainingJobEntity UUID of the job to resume

params.name: checkpoint
params.description: Specific checkpoint path to resume from (default: latest checkpoint)

results.name: resumed
results.description: Whether the job was successfully resumed

results.name: checkpointStep
results.description: Step number of the checkpoint being resumed from

results.name: crashCount
results.description: Number of times this job has been resumed (including this one)

results.name: sentinelHandle
results.description: New sentinel handle for the resumed training process
